name: Bon Scott
caption: An Australian up-and-comer billed as "the thunder from down under," who loses a Television Championship open challenge to Tazmanian Crippler after his own confident interview earlier the same broadcast.

name: Tazmanian Crippler
caption: DCWL's own first-ever Heavyweight Champion and, by his own count, its first Triple Crown holder, who retains the Television Championship over an open challenge from Bon Scott.

name: Stagg
caption: The DCWL Unified Heavyweight Champion, billed also as "Grandma Stagg," who publicly vacates the title on-air citing pressure from his own mother, "Ma Stagg," and hands it to El Juapo.

name: El Juapo
caption: Wins the vacated DCWL Unified Heavyweight Championship from Stagg in a token, pre-arranged eleven-second pinfall, having won a Tuesday battle royal to earn the spot; managed by Don Arturo.

name: John Clapp Sr.
caption: The DCWL's own in-fiction president and lead referee, a self-insert of the fed's own out-of-character operator, who officiates its own June 1997 broadcast and presides over the Unified Heavyweight Championship's own title change.

tenures.source: DCWL's own served June 1997 documents (promotions/dcwl/archive/, promotions/dcwl/rp/).

name: Maelstrom
caption: One half of the Elemental Force, a 6'10" giant who beats Destiny by submission on DCWL's own June 1997 broadcast and trash-talks the fed's other tag teams in its own roleplay-recruitment sample.

tenures.source: DCWL's own served 8 June 1997 broadcast and 17 June 1997 rp sample (promotions/dcwl/archive/, promotions/dcwl/rp/).

name: Monolith
caption: The other half of the Elemental Force, dryly unamused by his own partner's taunting in the fed's own roleplay-recruitment sample; no appearance of his own survives in the served card.

tenures.source: DCWL's own served 17 June 1997 rp sample (promotions/dcwl/rp/dcwl-looking-for-good-role-players-1997-06-17.html).

name: Destiny
caption: Billed as "one half of Damnation," loses to Maelstrom by submission on DCWL's own June 1997 broadcast while nursing a bandage from an earlier attack by the same rival faction referenced in the fed's own rp sample.

identity.note: 'Destiny' is a generic archetype ring name reused across two other unrelated wings already on file; no document ties DCWL's own billing ('one half of Damnation') to either. No-auto-merge default: distinct.
